purpose: Inspect the frozen source model's branch contributions and sensitivity to normal-domain channel-mean differences. Not model selection, training, a deployed preprocessing change or final Real evaluation.

datasets.source: Entire frozen source val.pt, 35520 endpoint-labeled windows; normal reference fitted from its 17912 label-0 windows, including pre-fault windows.
datasets.target: Only the 640 windows of the 10 frozen adapt_normal cases, all normal. This is in-sample normal diagnosis, not target generalization or target fault recall.

fixed_model: Original A0 only; all parameters and buffers unchanged, eval mode, no gradients, source normalization fixed.

feature_probes.reference: Fit delta[channel] = mean(target normalized frames) - mean(source label-0 normalized frames), once before sensitivity predictions. No scale fitting or factor search.
feature_probes.source_direction: Add delta to the selected channels of every source window, both normal and fault.
feature_probes.target_direction: Subtract delta from the selected channels of the same 640 target adaptation windows.
feature_probes.intervention: Constant translation within each window. No weights, BN statistics or stored input tensors modified. Keep all groups and report all probes.
feature_probes.limitations: Off-manifold diagnostic perturbations can break derived-feature and quaternion consistency. Different directions test sensitivity, not a single deployable adaptation method. Fitting and measuring on the same normal populations is descriptive and optimistic.

branch_probe.method: Exact frozen linear-head logit-margin decomposition: alpha*(raw_features dot w_fault_minus_normal) + (1-alpha)*(projected_relation_features dot w_fault_minus_normal) + bias_difference.
outputs: raw and relation signed margin contributions
per-window means of the nine relation inputs
branch_probe.limitations: Gate alpha alone is not branch importance; the contributions are a conditional algebraic decomposition, not independent causal attribution. No branch-only retraining or new classifier.

semantics_audit: Inspect relation operations on normalized channels: effort denominator clamp, cross-channel gaps, altitude sample difference versus normalized vel_z. Describe them as learned proxies, not strict physical residuals.
forbidden: choosing and running extra probes after seeing outcomes
preservation: New independent diagnostic protocol; original v1, BN development experiments, source caches, checkpoint and deployed models remain unchanged. No server connection.
